versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "scene-analysis" skill.
- Provides a structured tool for commercial scenario evaluation and assessment, supporting Gate0 strategic screening, Gate1 quantitative scoring, and blue-force (opposing team) auditing.
- Implements stepwise evaluation: Gate0 red-line filter ("去伪存真"), Gate1 scoring matrix for six key factors with risk deductions, and independent blue-force review.
- All assessments require evidence from user-provided scenario descriptions; logic-based deduction is allowed but must be clearly marked.
- Follows strict evaluation and rating rules, referencing supporting domain materials for standards and procedures.
- Includes examples for complete process execution and blue-force audit use cases.
